title: America's Seed Fund — NSF SBIR/STTR
status_label: Open pathway — begin with a Project Pitch
summary: Non-dilutive seed funding for U.S. startups developing high-risk deep technology with commercial potential.
eligibility_notes: Confirm current Project Pitch and solicitation requirements; the company must meet SBIR/STTR ownership and U.S. small-business rules.
readiness_items: Entity registration|Technical innovation narrative|Commercialization case|Project budget

title: Rural Energy for America Program
status_label: Grant cycle watch — guaranteed loans currently open
summary: Supports renewable-energy systems and energy-efficiency improvements for agricultural producers and eligible rural small businesses.
eligibility_notes: Verify rural-area eligibility, current grant window, project technology, cost share, and federal standing before proceeding.
readiness_items: Rural eligibility check|Energy assessment|Vendor estimates|Matching funds

title: Amber Grant
focus_areas: Economic development|Community services|Technology & innovation|Arts & culture|Health & wellness
summary: Monthly and year-end grants for women-owned businesses across industries, including eligible nonprofit ventures.
eligibility_notes: Confirm current rules, fees, category calendar, judging terms, and whether the applying venture meets the program's women-owned definition.

title: NASE Growth Grants
summary: Small growth grants for eligible NASE members to support defined business-development needs.
eligibility_notes: Verify membership duration, good standing, current quarterly deadline, and allowable use of funds.
readiness_items: Active membership|Use-of-funds plan|Business plan|Recent tax return or P&L|Business photo

title: State Trade Expansion Program referral pathway
status_label: Apply through a participating state or territory
summary: Export assistance delivered through state and territorial STEP awardees for eligible established small businesses.
eligibility_notes: This is not a direct SBA grant to the business. Contact the current state or territory awardee and verify local eligibility and covered export activities.

title: Community Food Projects Competitive Grants Program
sponsor: USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture
summary: Funds self-reliant community food projects addressing food and nutrition security and hunger.
eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include certain public food-program service providers, tribal organizations, and private nonprofit entities. Verify the next NOFO and matching requirement.
readiness_items: Federal registration|Community needs data|Partnerships|Logic model|Matching funds

title: Food Safety Outreach Program
sponsor: USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture
status_label: Current NOFOs closed — monitor next cycle
summary: Supports food-safety education, outreach, training, technical assistance, and grant-writing capacity for eligible organizations.
eligibility_notes: Verify the next NOFO. Applicants need an organizational eRA Commons account and must fall within a listed eligible category.
readiness_items: eRA Commons registration|Training plan|Audience evidence|Partnership roles

title: Grants for Arts Projects
status_label: FY 2026 cycles closed — new guidelines expected late 2026
summary: Project-based support for eligible nonprofit arts organizations, governments, and federally recognized tribes.
eligibility_notes: Nonprofits generally need five years of arts programming, at least $20,000 in recent operating expenses, federal registrations, and required cost share. Verify the next guidelines.
readiness_items: Five-year program history|SAM.gov registration|Project budget|Cost share|Work samples

title: Program for Investment in Microentrepreneurs
status_label: Annual cycle watch — typically announced in spring
summary: Supports eligible nonprofit microenterprise-development organizations providing capacity building, training, and technical assistance to disadvantaged microentrepreneurs.
eligibility_notes: This program funds eligible intermediary organizations, not ordinary business expansion. Verify the annual notice and applicant category.

title: AmeriCorps State and National Grants
summary: Supports evidence-informed national-service programs, including workforce pathways and services in rural and high-poverty communities.
eligibility_notes: Verify the next federal or state-commission competition, applicant type, match, evidence tier, performance measures, and operational-financial requirements.
readiness_items: Federal registration|Service model|Performance measures|Evidence base|Operational capacity
